comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Memory of the Ancient City Memorial Album, this is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Plain Flag
Sewing/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 250

Ingredients:
Mysterious Damask Rose x1
Banner of the Lion Heart x2
Ignis Solution x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: For all those recipes the "20% chance of success" is without any item, right? How much does Uroboros increase the chance? and is there anything else that helps? Any of the 3 Alchemy related titles help with success rate?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yes, 20% without any Atlantis buff or use of Uroboros. Uroboros makes any transmutation recipe 100% success. All ingredients are lost in the process but you get your desired item produced without incident.

As a result, no titles are needed when using Uroboros; I do not know if they are of any use if you don't use Uroboros but I would NOT want to risk it with a rare item like the Plain Flag to find out for certain. Cheers.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Thanks, I didn't knew was a 100% success, thought was just a boost on the %

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: Almost right Guildy. The base item, which in this example the plain flag, is not lost, just the ingredients

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I consider the base flag "lost" as when using production, it either transforms into the Persian flag (success) or disappears (fail). But perhaps I could have used different, more concise wording.

And if somehow base items aren't lost during failed production attempts, good to know -- I am not big on alchemy and avoid it at all costs so I never tried transmutation without Wingless or Uroboros books.
